overestimate_radius_2.description: Non-exact mass is split equally between one- and two-cell overestimation.

symmetric_radius_1.description: Non-exact mass is split equally between adjacent lower and higher cost cells.

symmetric_radius_2.description: Non-exact mass is split equally across one- and two-cell errors in either direction.

underestimate_radius_2.description: Non-exact mass is split equally between one- and two-cell underestimation.

limitations: The 10% simplex grid is exhaustive at that resolution but not a continuous prevalence-volume calculation.
Winner fractions count lattice profiles equally rather than weighting them by a deployment prior.
The estimator kernels remain sensitivity models rather than calibrated confusion matrices.
Expected regression is primary; worst-cell constraints can select different policies.
The audit reuses compact E83 path summaries and is not new GPU evidence.
model: Sweep every six-cell cost prevalence vector on the 10% simplex for each E88 estimator kernel and 1% accuracy point. Report prevalence-grid winners and distribution-free maximum per-cost regret.
